checkResults.description: CSS must be wrapped in @layer components

VFT-C1.prompt_excerpt: Write a StatusBadge component and its CSS. It shows a colored pill with text. Use @layer components for the CSS. Use only var(--shelf-*) tokens for all visual values — colors, spacing, border-radius, font-size. Include the CSS file.
VFT-C1.output:
`src/components/StatusBadge/StatusBadge.css` is written with:
- `@layer components` wrapping all rules
- Only `var(--shelf-status-badge-*)` tokens for every visual value (background, color, padding, border-radius, font-size, font-weight, line-height)
- Kebab-case class selectors (`.status-badge`, `.status-badge--read`, etc.)
- Modifier classes for each status variant: `--read`, `--reading`, `--want-to-read`

The companion `tokens.css` defines all `--shelf-status-badge-*` aliases (including dark-mode overrides in both `[data-theme="dark"]` and `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)`) so no raw values leak into the component layer.

<promise>COMPLETE</promise>
